summary: Niu Technologies filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 5, 2026, providing its third-quarter 2026 sales volume update. The Chinese electric mobility company reported total unit sales of 537,457 in 3Q26, up from 465,873 a year earlier, comprising 490,406 China-market units (+9% year-over-year) and 47,051 international units (versus 14,418). Year-to-date volume reached 1,233,768 units, compared with 1,019,276 in 2025. No transaction, pricing, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms were disclosed. This is an ordinary operational update, not a special situation; watch quarterly financials and margin trends rather than deal catalysts.
